pages.text: The Golden Witch advances the $(bold)Ten-Night Epitaph Ritual$(reset), gouging out the $(bold)head, chest, belly, knees, and feet$(reset) to apply movement, shield, or eating seals.$(br2)Upon entering Phase 2, she drags nearby players into $(bold)The Golden Land$(reset).
Drops Gold Blocks, Totem of Undying, Enchanted Golden Apple, and $(item)Beatrice's Pipe$(reset).
